title: POS control rail — feature development tracker

status.not-started: Rail button dispatches the default placeholder message.
status.partial: Some wiring exists but plan acceptance criteria (UX + TDD + E2E) are not met.
status.done: Plan fully developed: UI + backend + unit/component tests + dev E2E green.
status.backend-ready: Schema and API landed and tested; frontend rail wiring still pending.

class.OK: Backend endpoints already exist, only frontend wiring needed.

features.label: Total
features.notes: Checkout modal has quick-cash keys (exacto/5/10/20/50), live pending + change due, card terminal reference, and an in-flight guard so a double tap cannot double-charge; cash over the total settles exactly the ticket total. Covered by usePOSRegister.test.ts + POSSellScreen.test.tsx. Dev E2E pending M2 run.

features.label: Aparcar
features.notes: Rail opens a park modal with an optional note; parkVisit() PATCHes the visit, clears the register and parked comandas come back from the Aparcados list in the tables modal. Covered by usePOSRegister.test.ts + POSSellScreen.test.tsx (+ Go integration tests). Dev E2E pending.

features.label: Mesa
features.notes: Mesa opens a dine-in visit (table + covers + reservation prefill) and, when a visit is already active, switches the modal to 'Cambiar mesa': tapping a free table PATCHes /visits/{id} with the new tableId keeping covers and lines; occupied targets are refused client-side and by the backend (TABLE_OCCUPIED). Covered by usePOSRegister.test.ts + POSSellScreen.test.tsx. Dev E2E pending M2/M3 run.

features.label: Salón
features.notes: Bootstrap now returns areas[] and tables carry areaId/areaName; the tables modal shows area chips that filter the grid. Salón opens the floor directly. Covered by usePOSRegister.test.ts + POSSellScreen.test.tsx (+ Go integration tests). Dev E2E pending.

features.label: Juntar mesas
features.notes: Rail opens a merge modal listing other open visits; mergeVisits() calls POST /pos/visits/{id}/merge, consolidating lines and covers and freeing the source table. Covered by usePOSRegister.test.ts + POSSellScreen.test.tsx (+ Go integration tests). Dev E2E pending.

features.label: Borrar comanda
features.notes: Rail opens a confirm modal with a required reason; voidOrder() voids every active line, voids the ticket and cancels the visit. Covered by usePOSRegister.test.ts + POSSellScreen.test.tsx. Dev E2E pending M2 run.

features.label: Combinado
features.notes: Migration 078 modifier/pack schema is live, but there is no tenant catalogue UI yet, so the rail button explains that modifiers/packs must be configured in Catálogo instead of failing silently. Catalogue CRUD + line-modifier wiring still pending.

features.label: Cliente
features.notes: Rail opens a customer modal (name + NIF) persisted through PATCH /pos/visits/{id}/customer and pre-filled from the active visit. Covered by usePOSRegister.test.ts + POSSellScreen.test.tsx (+ Go integration tests). Dev E2E pending.

features.label: Cocina
features.notes: Register tracks sent-per-line quantities: pendingKitchenLines/hasPendingKitchenLines partition, dispatch only fires pending lines, lines show a 'Cocina' badge once sent and the rail button is disabled while nothing is pending. Covered by usePOSRegister.test.ts + POSSellScreen.test.tsx. Dev E2E pending M2 run.

features.label: Cajón
features.notes: Rail opens a drawer modal with reason chips (sin venta/cambio/arqueo); openDrawer() posts an idempotent, shift-gated drawer event. Covered by usePOSRegister.test.ts + POSSellScreen.test.tsx (+ Go integration tests). Dev E2E pending.

features.label: Descuento
features.notes: Rail opens a discount modal with €/% toggle, live preview and required reason; applyDiscount(amountCents, reason) clamps to ticket total and no longer uses window.prompt. Covered by usePOSRegister.test.ts + POSSellScreen.test.tsx. Dev E2E pending M2 run.

features.label: Recargo
features.notes: Rail opens a surcharge modal with €/% toggle and required reason, posting to /tickets/{id}/adjustments; discount and surcharge coexist and VAT is recomputed on the surcharged gross. Covered by usePOSRegister.test.ts + POSSellScreen.test.tsx (+ Go integration tests). Dev E2E pending.

features.label: Invita
features.notes: Rail comps the selected line with a required reason; the line stays ACTIVE so kitchen and stock still fire while its charge drops to zero. Covered by usePOSRegister.test.ts + POSSellScreen.test.tsx (+ Go integration tests). Dev E2E pending.

features.label: Empleado
features.notes: Rail assigns an operator member to the open ticket via PATCH /pos/tickets/{id}/operator. Covered by usePOSRegister.test.ts + POSSellScreen.test.tsx (+ Go integration tests). Dev E2E pending.

features.label: Separar comanda
features.notes: Rail creates a sibling ticket; ticket panel shows split tabs (role=tablist) to switch accounts and a per-line move button; moveLine(line, quantity?) supports partial moves clamped to the line quantity. Covered by usePOSRegister.test.ts + POSSellScreen.test.tsx. Dev E2E pending M2 run.

features.label: Tags
features.notes: Rail loads the tenant tag catalogue and attaches the chosen tag to the selected line. Covered by usePOSRegister.test.ts + POSSellScreen.test.tsx (+ Go integration tests). Dev E2E pending.

features.label: Barra
features.notes: Rail opens a tableless, coverless BAR-channel visit (previously it wrongly opened TAKEAWAY). Covered by usePOSRegister.test.ts + POSSellScreen.test.tsx (+ Go integration tests). Dev E2E pending.

features.label: Comentario
features.notes: Rail saves a free-text note on the selected line; LinePatch now treats notes as optional so a quantity change no longer wipes an existing comment. Covered by usePOSRegister.test.ts + POSSellScreen.test.tsx (+ Go integration tests). Dev E2E pending.

features.label: Dividir comanda
features.notes: Divide modal splits the ticket total evenly by guest count via pages/app/pos/utils/splitShares.ts (remainder spread one cent per share, shares always sum back to the total) and pre-fills the checkout with one share. Covered by splitShares.test.ts + POSSellScreen.test.tsx. Persisted partial payments stay deferred to M4 per plan.

features.label: Suplemento
features.notes: Migration 078 modifier/pack schema is live, but there is no tenant catalogue UI yet, so the rail button explains that modifiers/packs must be configured in Catálogo instead of failing silently. Catalogue CRUD + line-modifier wiring still pending.

features.label: Propina
features.notes: Rail captures a tip that is added to the amount tendered at checkout and sent as payments[].tipCents, excluded from the sale total and VAT. Covered by usePOSRegister.test.ts + POSSellScreen.test.tsx (+ Go integration tests). Dev E2E pending.

features.label: Pack
features.notes: Migration 078 modifier/pack schema is live, but there is no tenant catalogue UI yet, so the rail button explains that modifiers/packs must be configured in Catálogo instead of failing silently. Catalogue CRUD + line-modifier wiring still pending.
